verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a datacenter AI accelerator for training and inference (PyTorch, DeepSpeed, vLLM, distributed training), not a consumer graphics card. Game upscaling and frame generation such as DLSS or FSR fall outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any gaming or graphics capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a gamer, AI upscaling and frame generation are supported on this card — the DLSS or FSR generation is documented for this part, with broad game support
